extracted_relations.evidence: Decimals combine integer and fractional parts.
Fractions are ratios of integers.
Percentage expresses a ratio per hundred.
Standard form rewrites decimal numbers using powers of ten.
Rounded bounds depend on significant figures.
Expressions use numerical constants and variables.
Linear equations are algebraic expressions set equal.
Quadratic equations extend linear equations to degree two.
Linear inequalities compare linear expressions.
Functions are often defined by algebraic expressions.
Coordinates are often integer grid points.
Gradient is computed from coordinates.
Line equation uses gradient m.
Parallel lines have equal gradients.
Perpendicular gradients multiply to -1.
Surface area sums face areas.
Prism volume uses base area times height.
Arc length depends on central angle.
Sector area uses radius and central angle.
Circle theorems describe angle relationships.
Similar figures have equal corresponding angles.
Congruent figures have equal angles and sides.
Sine rule uses angles and opposite sides.
Cosine rule uses sides and included angle.
Vectors can be represented by coordinates.
Translations use vector notation.
Probability uses outcomes in a sample space.
Tree diagrams model probability outcomes.
Conditional probability extends probability with given information.
